Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
Here is [the Reputed Changeling](../books.html#205).

It really is a much better story than [Beechcroft at Rockstone](../books.html#201) which was chiefly written to run on with the [Monthly Packet](../others.html#52) and satisfy people insatiable of continuations, so that as a young people’s tale it suffers from being treated as a novel.

Has it gone to [Tauchnitz](../persons.html#2124)?

What a curious book Reuben Sachs is!

Is [Amy Levy](../persons.html#2381) a genuine Jew- ?[^1]
She seems to have stripped off all the illusions, not to say realities! about the race

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Amy Levy, Reuben Sachs: A Sketch (London, Macmillan 1888), a novel about upper middle-class Jewish life in London.
